physical_description.build: Compact and densely muscled, low center of gravity â€” every gram is functional mass. Shoulders broad relative to frame, legs thick and powerful. Built like someone engineered to absorb and deliver impact.

physical_description.visible_augmentations: Smartgun link in right forearm â€” visible as a seamless chrome integration at the wrist, with faint data-port detents along the radial bone. Handshake is firm but not aggressive. In motion, they move like something wound tight.

Between jobs, they wear nearly identical outfits in neutral tones â€” easier to maintain cover identity if you never change the pattern.
